items.briefing:
Check Point is warning that cyber attacks are increasing globally, with AI being used to make threats more sophisticated — a concern for all Australian organisations, including registered training organisations (RTOs). Separately, a vulnerability has been identified in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which are commonly used e-commerce platforms. If your organisation uses either of these for online sales or enrolments, ensure your software is updated immediately.

**Practical tip:** Check with your IT support team today whether your website's e-commerce platform is up to date and patched against the latest known vulnerabilities.
